mapper.select: SELECT c.company_id AS companyId, c.company_name AS companyName, a.application_id AS eligibilityApplicationId, a.applicant_user_id AS authorUserId, jp.job_category_id AS jobCategoryId, jc.category_name AS jobCategoryName, '현직원' AS employmentStatus FROM applications a JOIN job_postings jp ON jp.job_posting_id = a.job_posting_id JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = jp.company_id LEFT JOIN job_categories jc ON jc.job_category_id = jp.job_category_id WHERE a.applicant_user_id = #{userId} AND jp.company_id = #{companyId} AND a.current_status = '입사완료' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM company_reviews cr WHERE cr.author_user_id = a.applicant_user_id AND cr.company_id = jp.company_id ) ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
ROUND(AVG(overall_rating),1) AS overallRating,
COUNT(*) AS reviewCount,
ROUND(AVG(career_growth_rating),1) AS careerGrowthRating,
ROUND(AVG(work_satisfaction_rating),1) AS workSatisfactionRating,
ROUND(AVG(compensation_rating),1) AS compensationRating,
ROUND(AVG(culture_rating),1) AS cultureRating,
SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(overall_rating) = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rating5Count, SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(overall_rating) = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rating4Count, SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(overall_rating) = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rating3Count, SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(overall_rating) = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rating2Count, SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(overall_rating) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rating1Count
FROM company_reviews
WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status='정상'

SELECT cr.company_review_id, cr.company_id, cr.author_user_id, cr.eligibility_application_id,
cr.employment_status, cr.job_category_id, jc.category_name AS jobCategoryName,
cr.career_growth_rating, cr.work_satisfaction_rating, cr.compensation_rating, cr.culture_rating,
cr.overall_rating,
cr.pros, cr.cons, cr.summary,
cr.status,
cr.hidden_reason, cr.hidden_by,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_reactions rr WHERE rr.review_type = '기업리뷰' AND rr.review_id = cr.company_review_id) AS helpCount,
cr.created_at, cr.updated_at
FROM company_reviews cr
LEFT JOIN job_categories jc ON cr.job_category_id = jc.job_category_id
WHERE cr.company_id = #{companyId} AND cr.status = '정상'
ORDER BY helpCount DESC, cr.created_at DESC
ORDER BY cr.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM company_reviews
WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status='정상'

SELECT
COUNT(*) AS reviewCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN ir.interview_result = '합격' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ir.interview_result = '불합격' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ir.interview_result = '대기' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waitingCount,
ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN ir.interview_result = '합격' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 0 ) AS passPercent,
ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN ir.interview_result = '불합격' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 0 ) AS failPercent,
ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN ir.interview_result = '대기' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 0 ) AS waitingPercent,
( SELECT difficulty FROM interview_reviews WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status = '정상' GROUP BY difficulty ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS difficulty,
MAX(jp.process_text) AS processText
FROM interview_reviews ir
LEFT JOIN job_postings jp ON ir.job_posting_id = jp.job_posting_id
WHERE ir.company_id = #{companyId} AND ir.status = '정상'

SELECT
ir.interview_review_id, ir.company_id, ir.author_user_id, ir.job_posting_id, ir.application_id,
ir.interview_month, ir.interview_type, ir.interview_result, ir.difficulty,
ir.process_text,
ir.content, ir.tips,
ir.status,
ir.hidden_reason, ir.hidden_by,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_reactions rr WHERE rr.review_type = '면접후기' AND rr.review_id = ir.interview_review_id) AS helpCount,
ir.created_at, ir.updated_at,
jp.title, jp.career_type
FROM interview_reviews ir
LEFT JOIN job_postings jp ON ir.job_posting_id = jp.job_posting_id
WHERE ir.company_id = #{companyId} AND ir.status = '정상'
ORDER BY helpCount DESC, ir.created_at DESC
ORDER BY ir.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM interview_reviews
WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status = '정상'

SELECT c.company_id AS companyId, c.company_name AS companyName, a.application_id AS applicationId, a.applicant_user_id AS authorUserId, jp.job_posting_id AS jobPostingId, jp.title, jp.career_type AS careerType, COALESCE(jp.process_text, '면접') AS processText, DATE_FORMAT(a.updated_at, '%Y-%m') AS interviewMonth, CASE WHEN a.current_status = '불합격' THEN '불합격' WHEN a.current_status IN ('최종합격', '입사완료') THEN '합격' ELSE '대기' END AS interviewResult FROM applications a JOIN job_postings jp ON jp.job_posting_id = a.job_posting_id JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = jp.company_id WHERE a.applicant_user_id = #{userId} AND jp.company_id = #{companyId} AND a.current_status IN ('면접완료', '최종합격', '입사완료', '불합격') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM interview_reviews ir WHERE ir.application_id = a.application_id ) ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_reviews ( company_id, author_user_id, job_posting_id, application_id, interview_month, interview_type, interview_result, difficulty, process_text, content, tips ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{authorUserId}, #{jobPostingId}, #{applicationId}, #{interviewMonth}, #{interviewType}, #{interviewResult}, #{difficulty}, #{processText}, #{content}, #{tips} )

choose.when: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM company_reviews WHERE company_review_id = #{reviewId} AND status = '정상'
choose.otherwise: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interview_reviews WHERE interview_review_id = #{reviewId} AND status = '정상'

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_reactions (user_id, review_type, review_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{reviewType}, #{reviewId})

INSERT INTO company_reviews ( company_id, author_user_id, eligibility_application_id, employment_status, job_category_id,
career_growth_rating, work_satisfaction_rating, compensation_rating, culture_rating, overall_rating,
pros, cons, summary ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{authorUserId}, #{eligibilityApplicationId}, #{employmentStatus}, #{jobCategoryId},
#{careerGrowthRating}, #{workSatisfactionRating}, #{compensationRating}, #{cultureRating}, #{overallRating},
#{pros}, #{cons}, #{summary} )
